title: Ideas inventory unlabelled-owner and nested-route tranche
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: partial actual grouped-owner crosswalk review; census versus semantic/runtime scope and donor consolidation retained
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual new review covers original731–840: standalone world-depth grouped file/code families, progression GTR/GTC/GTO and world-gate families, unlabelled root/generic-owner groups, remaining explicit-action-owner themes and nested research/dispatch routes through the full-census heading. Together B534–B541 cover original1–840 only; original841–1169 remains. This reads each crosswalk row and its status/locator/effort/check fields, not every code or source named inside a grouped row. The6214 coded-row figure is the old extraction's count, not6214 current reviewed claims.

F2: Missing numbered world-depth filenames25–27/42 are census facts, not missing intended features. Grouped home/hub, start/access, cross-world, social, health, title, reveal and microtexture palettes remain useful under their actual world/role/body/knowledge owners. Calling a file foundational or required does not make every illustrative row a product gate. ACT/ACCOUNT/LATER, passive texture and live consumers stay distinct; a reference row or specified initial slice is not played breadth. Current AD46 permits rankless/multi-axis growth; no ladder, numerical field or lore example is universal. GTR/GTC names remain proposal codes rather than adopted rules.

F3: GTO's own row records actual base.frontier single-gain cap proof while its generic state cell says proposal; preserve that bounded delivery without crediting spill/pressure, Mistglass conversion or all world gates. A validated descriptor needs a reader, admission/commit and current-state consequence. Gate availability, crossing, overflow policy and path view are different contracts. LOTM/RI/Shadow Slave/skill-grinder/MoL source proposals and their old no-live-gate labels require current exact owners before use. High-tier source ambition is not all-source or all-world delivery, and October24 retirement of the one-realm/prestige gate supersedes the stale nonhuman milestone sentence. Human review remains optional under AD42.

F4: Zero hits under explicit ACCOUNT/LATER headings did not mean zero ideas. The root and nested-theme inventory usefully recovers those proposals without proving source absence or giving every heading a separate implementation queue. Companion care/bond/control, comic revision/identity, forecast basis and isolated seeds, hunger/body needs, equipment/stat readers, gear chemistry, local dials and authored world grammar retain their mechanisms and local constraints. B511/B512 complete companion/genetics owner reviews and B532/B533 complete engine/UI owners; their later corrections supersede early blanket constraints without implementing all proposals. The generic engine state cell cannot erase AD39 or the delivered frozen-host/mirror/MCP subset; likewise broad skills/tools cells retain SLL7/11/12 and IP1–3 proof already noted elsewhere.

F5: The weapon/rune row explicitly describes consolidation, not four independent backlogs. Three donor stubs and the canonical weapon/rune alias/moved-row sections already preserve original IDs and history, as checked earlier in this project reconciliation. Do not redo a pending ownership decision or delete donors merely because this table calls them duplicates. Reedbank A1/A2 and selected gear GDP slices retain their exact native/persistence proofs while other RS/GDP/GX/CRL ideas remain separate. Roster names, old module counts, code maps and effort estimates are not fresh runtime evidence. DESIGN/UI_RULES own current appearance and interaction; thematic/identity/layout palettes remain useful candidates beneath those owners.

F6: Nested Proto23 flow/crafting, death/reset, local AI, Hogwarts Legacy, tabletop, UI R5/R6/R14, cheat W1–W5, starts/continuity, HP Polyjuice, ruins/site, Xeus follow-up and palette-completion records are heterogeneous. Source comparisons, process receipts, detailed proposals, native delivery and actual discovery have different authority. B528/B531 qualify later Vivid/Xeus/preset claims; model/device speed, fork state, package/route availability and provider balance are dated. Death/recovery, carried faculties, player display disguise versus NPC perception, observer-known odds and transformed source identity follow their current actual owners, not one imported source rule. A private pack title or filename does not grant secret knowledge. No prompt/transcript imperative, model route, old dispatch, source purchase, native control or worker is activated by this crosswalk. A source-census exclusion is separate from this task's wider inventoried intake and does not erase the current obligation to review included documents.
reviews.evidence: Original731–770 read completely;771–810 dense output lost middle recovered783–794;811–840 read completely. Earlier B534–B540 cover1–730. Underlying leaf palettes/source/runtimes not reviewed by these group rows. Original841–1169 remains uncredited.
